description: This file contains unit tests for the SearchSource component within the org.eclipse.ditto.services.utils.search package. It tests various scenarios like empty streams, client errors, partial dissync, resume at start, and cursor deleted, using Akka Streams and testing tools. It verifies interactions with external components such as pub/sub mediator and concierge forwarder, as well as handling of retrieved 'Thing' objects and related responses.

classes.name: SearchSourceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for SearchSource, testing various streaming scenarios and interactions with external components.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem, Materializer, and TestProbes before each test.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after each test.

methods.name: emptyStream
methods.description: Tests behavior when the stream is empty and completes normally.

methods.name: clientError
methods.description: Tests behavior when the client encounters an invalid RQL expression error.

methods.name: nonemptyStreamWithPartialDissync
methods.description: Tests partial dissync handling during a non-empty stream.

methods.name: resumeAtStart
methods.description: Tests resume functionality starting from a specific cursor.

methods.name: cursorDeleted
methods.description: Tests behavior when the cursor is deleted or becomes invalid during stream processing, including re-fetching the last thing.

methods.name: getThing
methods.description: Constructs a mock Thing object with a numerical id.

methods.name: retrieveThingResponse
methods.description: Creates a mock RetrieveThingResponse for a given id.

methods.name: retrieveThing
methods.description: Creates a mock RetrieveThing request object with optional selected fields.

methods.name: materializeSourceProbe
methods.description: Creates and returns a test SourceRef along with the associated probe for testing.

methods.name: streamThings
methods.description: Creates a StreamThings request with optional sort values.

methods.name: startTestSearchSource
methods.description: Sets up and starts the SearchSource under test with specific parameters, returning a probe for the sink.
